# Tall-e

> Prompt engineering, conversation design, and AI persona work — portfolio of Tally Brostowsky.

Tall-e (tall-e.nl) is the professional portfolio of Tally Brostowsky, a Netherlands-based prompt engineer and conversation designer with over two decades in tech. She started as a software developer, moved into product management (leading one of the most successful mobile apps in the country), and now specialises in the intersection of brand voice and generative AI.

Her work focuses on translating user intent into user delight — finding the essence of a brand's personality and bringing it to life through words, whether in traditional UX copy, embedded AI, or Convobots (AI-powered conversational experiences).

## Skills

- Prompt engineering
- AI conversation design
- UX writing
- AI persona design (giving AI models a distinct, consistent character)

## Personified AI demo

An interactive demo that shows what AI persona design looks like in practice. Pick a persona, ask it anything, and compare the responses side-by-side. Same model, same question — only the persona prompt changes. Available at /personified-ai.

## Conversation Design projects

Products where the conversation is the experience — designed from the ground up around how people actually talk:

- **It's Not You, It's Me** (itsnotyouitsme.nl) — a breakup message writer; guides you through a short conversation and writes the tough "it's over" message so you don't have to
- **Surprise Me, Silly** (surprisemesilly.nl) — a privacy-first gift finder; asks smart questions about the recipient and surfaces thoughtful, curated ideas — experiences, local finds, acts of kindness

## Featured work — Convobots

Live demos of AI-powered conversations, each built around a distinct persona prompt:

- **Teenage-buddy Kai** (kai-convobot.tall-e.nl) — a friendly companion for teens; conversational, playful, supportive
- **Pubquiz Rick** (rick-convobot.tall-e.nl) — a Dutch pub quiz host using RAG for localised trivia; recreates the social atmosphere of a real quiz night
- **CV Bot** (cv-convobot.tall-e.nl) — an interactive CV reader; answers questions about Tally's background using her CV as a RAG source
